status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.unseal_mode_manual_description: Unseal keys are required after every restart
status.configure_first_description: Set the host name and the unseal mode to start OpenBao.
status.initialize_description: Run the command below on the server: it initializes OpenBao, prints the unseal keys and the root token in your terminal and unseals it. Store them in safe, separate places: they are shown only once. The OpenBao web UI can initialize it too, but copy the keys as soon as they appear.
status.initialize_description_auto: Run the command below on the server: it initializes OpenBao and prints the recovery keys and the root token in your terminal. Store them in safe, separate places: they are shown only once. The OpenBao web UI can initialize it too, but copy the keys as soon as they appear.
status.sealed_description: Secrets cannot be accessed until OpenBao is unsealed. Open the OpenBao web UI and enter {threshold} of the {shares} unseal keys. Keys entered so far: {progress}.
status.sealed_auto_description: Automatic unseal did not succeed. Check the system logs of the application.
status.not_running_description: Check the system logs of the application for errors.
status.unseal_mode_transit_description: OpenBao unseals itself with an external Transit server
status.root_token_title: A root token is still active
status.root_token_description: Root tokens have unlimited access. Once other administrator access works, revoke them by running on the server: {command}
status.module_token_title: Enable consistent backups and root token checks
status.module_token_description: Give the module a limited token: backups then include a consistent Raft snapshot, and this page warns about active root tokens. Run on the server: {command}
status.migration_waiting_keys: OpenBao is waiting for the keys: run 'bao operator unseal -migrate' once per key, then finish the migration on the server.
status.migration_finish: When the keys have been provided, complete it on the server: {command}
status.ha_state_unknown: State available when OpenBao is unsealed
status.ha_peers_need_module_token: Create the module token to list the Raft members.
status.plugins_installed: No optional plugin | 1 optional plugin | {count} optional plugins

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: OpenBao API and web UI are published at this address
settings.unseal_mode_manual_description: OpenBao starts sealed after every restart, including updates and node reboots. An operator must enter the unseal keys. The keys never touch the server disk.
settings.unseal_mode_auto_description: A static key, generated and stored on the node and included in backups, unseals OpenBao at startup. Anyone with access to the node disk or to the backup can decrypt the stored secrets.
settings.unseal_mode_locked: The unseal mode cannot be changed after OpenBao is initialized
settings.unseal_mode_cannot_verify: Start OpenBao before changing the unseal mode
settings.restart_warning_description: Changing the host name or the unseal mode restarts OpenBao. With manual unseal it must be unsealed again afterwards.
settings.audit_log_helper: Record every OpenBao request in the system logs. Sensitive values are hashed.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Domain already used by another application
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.directory_description: Let the users of a NethServer user domain log in to OpenBao with their account. Members of the administrators group get full access to OpenBao.
settings.ldap_admin_group_helper: Members of this group get the ns8-admin policy, with full access to OpenBao
settings.auto_initialize: Initialize OpenBao automatically with directory login
settings.auto_initialize_warning_title: No root token and no recovery keys
settings.auto_initialize_warning_description: OpenBao initializes itself and members of the administrators group can log in at once. No root token or recovery keys are generated: after the first login, generate recovery keys with "bao operator rotate-keys -init -target=recovery" and store them in a safe place.
settings.ldap_admin_group_not_found: Group not found in the user domain
settings.ldap_admin_group_cannot_verify: Cannot verify the group: the user domain does not answer
settings.auto_initialize_requires_user_domain: Automatic initialization requires a user domain
settings.notifications_description: Send an email when OpenBao goes down or is sealed, and when it recovers. Messages are sent through the cluster SMTP smarthost. Cluster alert recipients are also notified by the NethServer alert system.
settings.smarthost_disabled_description: Email notifications cannot be sent until the cluster SMTP smarthost is enabled.
settings.notify_recipients_helper: Comma-separated email addresses. Leave empty to disable notifications
settings.notify_recipients_required: Enter at least one email address
settings.smarthost_disabled: The cluster SMTP smarthost is not enabled
settings.test_email_failed_description: Check the SMTP smarthost settings and the system logs of the application.
settings.ldap_plugin_missing: The OpenBao LDAP auth plugin is not available on this node: update the module
settings.ip_allowlist_helper: One IP address or network (CIDR) per line. Leave empty to allow everybody
settings.ip_allowlist_warning_description: Only the listed networks can reach the OpenBao web UI and API, including applications that read secrets. Check that your own address is listed before saving.
settings.group_policies_description: Give more directory groups access to OpenBao with a policy. Built-in policies are created by the module; you can also type the name of a policy created in OpenBao.
settings.group_policy_incomplete: Choose both a group and a policy in every row
settings.ldap_group_not_found: Group not found in the user domain: {group}
settings.policy_ns8_secrets_rw: Read and write secrets in secret/
settings.policy_ns8_pki_issuer: Issue certificates from the internal CA
settings.starter_kits_description: Components prepared for you when OpenBao initializes itself, or when you run the command below on an initialized OpenBao. Existing components are never changed.
settings.kit_kv_description: A key/value (version 2) store at secret/, for passwords and other application secrets.
settings.kit_pki_description: A root CA at pki/ and an ns8-server role to issue TLS certificates for internal services.
settings.kit_approle_description: Lets applications and scripts log in with a role ID and a secret ID.
settings.apply_config_description: OpenBao is already initialized or uses manual unseal, so the module cannot change it without an administrator token. After saving, run this command on the server and enter an OpenBao token when prompted: it applies directory login, group policies and starter kits. Run it again after changing them, or if the user domain credentials change.
settings.unseal_mode_transit_description: The key that protects OpenBao is held by the Transit engine of another OpenBao or Vault server. OpenBao unseals itself while that server is reachable; no key is stored on this node.
settings.transit_address_required: Enter the URL of the Transit server
settings.transit_key_required: Enter the name of the Transit key
settings.transit_token_missing: Store the Transit token on the node first
settings.transit_token_missing_description: For security the token is never entered here: run this command on the server and paste the token when asked. It needs update access to the encrypt and decrypt paths of the key.
settings.vpn_api_helper: Also publish the OpenBao API on the cluster VPN, for NethServer modules and services on other nodes. Traffic is encrypted by the cluster VPN.
settings.vpn_api_port_unavailable: No free TCP port for the cluster network API
settings.public_access_helper: Publish the OpenBao web UI and API through the node web server on the host name. Turn it off to reach OpenBao only from the cluster network.
settings.public_access_off_title: OpenBao is not published on the host name
settings.public_access_off_description: Only NethServer nodes and modules can reach OpenBao, on the cluster network API address. Clients using the host name stop working.
settings.public_access_requires_vpn_api: Enable the cluster network API, otherwise nobody can reach OpenBao.
settings.snapshots_description: Keep daily Raft snapshots on this node, to recover quickly from a deleted secret or a wrong change. Backups already include a snapshot; these are an extra, local safety net.
settings.snapshot_keep_helper: 0 disables them. Snapshots are taken once a day
settings.snapshot_token_missing_description: Snapshots are taken with the module token. Create it on the server: {command}
settings.snapshot_restore_description: Restoring replaces all OpenBao data and needs an administrator token: run on the server, choosing the snapshot name:
settings.ha_description: Join several OpenBao instances, on different nodes, into one Raft cluster: if the active node stops, a standby takes over. A single instance works as before; nothing changes unless you choose a role here.
settings.ha_role_standalone_description: A single OpenBao instance, as in a normal installation.
settings.ha_role_primary_description: Other OpenBao instances can join this one. Its Raft cluster port and its cluster network API are published on the node VPN address. Requires manual or Transit unseal: members cannot share the key of automatic unseal.
settings.ha_role_member_description: This instance becomes a member of the Raft cluster of another instance and shares its data, seal and logins. Only possible before this instance is initialized.
settings.ha_join_required: Choose the OpenBao instance to join
settings.ha_no_candidates_description: In the Settings of an existing OpenBao instance, choose "Accept members" in High availability first.
settings.ha_join_seal_manual: The cluster uses manual unseal: after joining, unseal this instance with the unseal keys of the cluster. It joins when it is unsealed.
settings.ha_join_seal_transit: The cluster uses Transit unseal: this instance uses the same Transit key and unseals itself. Store the Transit token on this node first.
settings.ha_primary_notice_title: Members join through the cluster network
settings.ha_primary_notice_description: Turning this on restarts OpenBao (with manual unseal, unseal it again). If it is already initialized, its Raft address moves from loopback to the node VPN address; a copy of the previous Raft files is kept. Use 3 instances: 2 cannot survive the loss of one.
settings.ha_member_locked: This instance is a member of a Raft cluster: to leave it, remove the peer from the cluster and remove the application.
settings.ha_join_not_found: The chosen instance does not accept members any more
settings.ha_join_no_api: The chosen instance does not publish its cluster network API
settings.ha_requires_shared_seal: High availability requires manual or Transit unseal
settings.ha_member_requires_uninitialized: Only an OpenBao that is not initialized yet can join or leave a cluster
settings.ha_cannot_verify_storage: Cannot verify the OpenBao storage state: start OpenBao and retry
settings.ha_cannot_verify_peers: Cannot read the Raft members: create the module token first
settings.ha_primary_has_members: Other members are still in the Raft cluster: remove them first
settings.ha_port_unavailable: No TCP port available for the Raft cluster listener
settings.auto_initialize_not_for_members: A member does not initialize itself: it joins an initialized OpenBao

wizard.title: OpenBao setup
wizard.welcome_title: Set up your OpenBao secrets manager
wizard.welcome_description: This wizard prepares OpenBao in a few steps and explains each choice. Nothing is changed until you apply the configuration in the last step.
wizard.advanced_description: You can close this wizard and configure every option from the Settings page.
wizard.web_description: Choose the address of the OpenBao web interface and API. Applications and users connect to it, so it must be a name that resolves to this server.
wizard.host_helper: For example vault.example.org. The DNS record must point to this server
wizard.lets_encrypt_helper: Requires the host name to be reachable from the Internet on port 80
wizard.unseal_description: OpenBao keeps its data encrypted. After every start it must be unsealed before secrets can be read. This choice cannot be changed once OpenBao is initialized.
wizard.manual_pro: Most secure: the unseal keys are held by people, never stored on the server.
wizard.manual_con: After every restart, update or reboot, someone must enter the unseal keys. Until then, applications cannot read secrets.
wizard.manual_when: Choose it for highly sensitive secrets, with administrators available to unseal.
wizard.auto_pro: Always available: OpenBao unseals itself after restarts, updates and reboots.
wizard.auto_con: The unseal key is stored on this server and in its backups: whoever gets both the disk or backup can decrypt the secrets.
wizard.auto_when: Choose it when availability matters most and the server and backups are well protected. Required for automatic directory login setup.
wizard.directory_description: Let users of a NethServer user domain (OpenLDAP or Active Directory) log in to OpenBao with their account. Members of the group you choose become OpenBao administrators.
wizard.no_user_domains_description: This cluster has no user domain yet. You can create one from Domains and users and enable directory login later from Settings.
wizard.directory_later_title: Directory login is set up after initialization
wizard.directory_later_manual: With manual unseal, OpenBao cannot set itself up. After you initialize OpenBao, run the command shown at the end of this wizard with the root token.
wizard.directory_later_initialized: OpenBao is already initialized: run the command shown at the end of this wizard with an administrator token.
wizard.notifications_description: Receive an email when OpenBao stops working or is sealed, and when it recovers. Optional: leave empty to skip.
wizard.smarthost_disabled_description: Emails are sent through the cluster SMTP smarthost, which is not configured yet. You can save recipients now and configure the smarthost later.
wizard.review_description: Check your choices. Applying them starts OpenBao.
wizard.done_self_init: OpenBao is initializing itself with directory login. In a few seconds, members of the administrators group can log in with their directory account. No root token or keys were created.
wizard.done_recovery_keys: After your first login, generate recovery keys and keep them in a safe place. Without them, administrator access cannot be recovered if directory login stops working:
wizard.done_initialize: One last step: initialize OpenBao. This creates its keys and first administrator token, which are shown only once and never stored by NethServer.
wizard.init_step_open: Click Open OpenBao below: its web interface shows the initialization page.
wizard.init_step_shares_manual: Choose how many unseal keys to create and how many are needed to unseal, for example 5 and 3, then initialize.
wizard.init_step_shares_auto: Initialize. OpenBao creates recovery keys, used only to recover administrator access.
wizard.init_step_save: Download or copy the root token and every key, and store them in safe, separate places. They cannot be shown again.
wizard.init_step_unseal: Enter the required number of unseal keys to unseal OpenBao.
wizard.init_step_login: Sign in with the Token method, using the root token.
wizard.init_step_ldap: Enable directory login: run this command on the server and paste the root token when asked.
wizard.init_step_revoke: When administrator access is ready, revoke the root token.
wizard.manual_reminder_description: After every restart, update or reboot, open OpenBao and enter the unseal keys. The Status page and email notifications tell you when it is sealed.
wizard.done_setup_ldap: To apply the directory login settings, run this command on the server and paste an OpenBao administrator token when asked:
wizard.transit_configured: Configured in Settings: an external Transit server unseals OpenBao.
wizard.setup_mode: What do you want to set up?
wizard.setup_mode_new_description: Start a new, independent secrets store.
wizard.setup_mode_join: Join an existing OpenBao (high availability, experimental)
wizard.setup_mode_join_description: Add this instance to the Raft cluster of an OpenBao instance that accepts members, so a standby can take over.
wizard.join_description: Choose the OpenBao instance to join. This instance takes its data, seal and logins: no separate initialization is needed.
wizard.join_transit_token: Store the Transit token on this node before applying:
wizard.join_quorum_description: A Raft cluster keeps working while a majority of its members runs: 2 instances stop if either one stops. Use 3 instances.
wizard.done_joined_manual: This instance is joining the cluster. Open its web UI and unseal it with the unseal keys of the cluster: it completes the join when it is unsealed, then works as a standby.
wizard.done_joined_transit: This instance is joining the cluster and unseals itself with the Transit key. It then works as a standby.
wizard.init_cli_description_manual: Run this command on the server (for example in the cluster-admin terminal or over SSH). It prints the unseal keys and the root token in your terminal, where they stay until you copy them, then unseals OpenBao. Nothing is stored by NethServer.
wizard.init_cli_description_auto: Run this command on the server (for example in the cluster-admin terminal or over SSH). It prints the recovery keys and the root token in your terminal, where they stay until you copy them. Nothing is stored by NethServer.
wizard.init_ui_title: Or: initialize from the OpenBao web interface
wizard.init_ui_warning_title: Copy the keys as soon as they appear
wizard.init_ui_warning_description: The web interface may move on to the next page by itself right after initializing, and the keys and root token are never shown again. Use the Download button, or prefer the command above.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Add authentication methods, secrets engines and database plugins from the official openbao-plugins project. Nothing is downloaded until you enable a plugin: then its image, pinned by digest, is downloaded, its binary is verified and OpenBao loads it. Configuring a plugin is done in OpenBao with an administrator token: credentials never pass through NethServer.
plugins.step_enable: 1. Enable it in OpenBao, with an administrator token (bao login):
plugins.step_configure: 2. Configure it: first steps, replace the values in <angle brackets>:
plugins.remove_warning_description: Disable the auth method or secrets engine that uses this plugin (bao auth disable / bao secrets disable) before removing it, otherwise that mount stops working.
plugins.restart_description: Applying the plugin changes restarts OpenBao. With manual unseal, unseal it again afterwards.
plugins.plugin_download_failed: Cannot download the plugins: {plugins}. Check that the node can reach ghcr.io.
plugins.desc_auth_ldap: Log in with a directory account (NethServer user domains, LDAP, Active Directory). Used by directory login.
plugins.desc_auth_aws: Log in with AWS IAM credentials or EC2 instance identity.
plugins.desc_auth_azure: Log in with Azure managed identities and service principals.
plugins.desc_auth_gcp: Log in with Google Cloud service accounts or GCE instance identity.
plugins.desc_auth_github: Log in with a GitHub personal access token; map organization teams to policies.
plugins.desc_auth_kerberos: Log in with Kerberos (SPNEGO) tickets of an Active Directory or MIT realm.
plugins.desc_auth_radius: Log in with credentials checked by a RADIUS server.
plugins.desc_secrets_aws: Generate short-lived AWS access credentials from IAM policies.
plugins.desc_secrets_azure: Generate Azure service principals with role and group assignments.
plugins.desc_secrets_gcp: Generate Google Cloud service account keys and OAuth tokens.
plugins.desc_secrets_gcpkms: Encrypt and decrypt data with keys managed by Google Cloud KMS.
plugins.desc_secrets_ldap: Manage and rotate LDAP and Active Directory account passwords.
plugins.desc_database_mongodb: Generate dynamic MongoDB database users (database secrets engine).
